is_anopheles.evidence: Identified Anopheles coluzzii and Anopheles arabiensis from indoor resting collections in Gounougou, Cameroon (Page 1, Abstract).

reports_target_markers.evidence: Genotyped Vgsc L1014F (L995F) via TaqMan and identified L1014S (L995S) by sequencing VGSC exon 20 (Pages 1, 7, 9, Table 1).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 1 (Page 7) provides exact genotype counts (SS, RR, RS) for 1014F in An. coluzzii (SS=7, RR=25, RS=27, total=59) and An. arabiensis (SS=18, RR=0, RS=0, total=18).

african_field_population.evidence: Blood-fed indoor-resting female mosquitoes were collected in August 2017 in Gounougou, northern Cameroon (Page 3).

is_primary_study.evidence: Primary research article reporting original empirical field collections, bioassays, and molecular genotyping.

duplicate_risk.evidence: Original collection conducted in August 2017 specifically for this study.

supplement.evidence: All main genotype count data and bioassay results are fully contained in Table 1 and main text.

assessment.summary: Primary empirical study evaluating pyrethroid and DDT resistance in Anopheles coluzzii and Anopheles arabiensis collected in Gounougou, Cameroon in August 2017. Genotyping of Vgsc L1014F (L995F) showed a frequency of 65.25% in An. coluzzii (N=59), while sequencing identified a single An. arabiensis carrying the Vgsc 1014S (L995S) mutation.
